reviewText: Finally a logic game that isn't just mindless tapping. The spatial grid mechanics are super sharp and the motherboard design feels really premium on my phone.
Bohot sahi game hai, dimag lagana padta hai. No ads and clean interface, bilkul smooth chalti hai mere phone pe.
The spatial reasoning levels are quite challenging. I love the tactical blueprint feature, it really helps when you get stuck on the tougher motherboard puzzles.
